WITH months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT month_label AS month
  FROM calendar_days
  WHERE year_num = 2025
),
order_calc AS (
  SELECT
    strftime(o.placed_at, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    o.grand_total / CASE WHEN o.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE er.rate END AS revenue_eur,
    o.discount_total / CASE WHEN o.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE er.rate END AS discount_eur,
    CASE WHEN o.discount_total > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_discount
  FROM orders o
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
    AND er.quote_code = o.currency_code
    AND er.as_of = date(o.placed_at)
  WHERE o.placed_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND o.placed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
),
order_agg AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    COUNT(*) AS orders_count,
    SUM(has_discount) AS orders_with_discount_count,
    SUM(revenue_eur) AS total_order_revenue_eur,
    SUM(discount_eur) AS total_discount_amount_eur
  FROM order_calc
  GROUP BY month
),
coupon_agg AS (
  SELECT
    strftime(cr.redeemed_at, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.coupon_id) AS distinct_coupons_used
  FROM coupon_redemptions cr
  WHERE cr.redeemed_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND cr.redeemed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT
  m.month,
  COALESCE(oa.orders_count, 0) AS orders_count,
  COALESCE(oa.orders_with_discount_count, 0) AS orders_with_discount_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(oa.orders_with_discount_count, 0)::numeric * 100.0 / NULLIF(oa.orders_count,0), 1) AS discount_rate_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(oa.total_order_revenue_eur,0)::numeric, 0) AS total_order_revenue_eur,
  ROUND(COALESCE(oa.total_discount_amount_eur,0)::numeric, 0) AS total_discount_amount_eur,
  ROUND(COALESCE(oa.total_discount_amount_eur,0)::numeric * 100.0 / NULLIF(oa.total_order_revenue_eur + oa.total_discount_amount_eur, 0), 1) AS discount_share_of_gmv_pct,
  COALESCE(ca.distinct_coupons_used, 0) AS distinct_coupons_used,
  ROUND(COALESCE(oa.total_discount_amount_eur,0)::numeric / NULLIF(oa.orders_with_discount_count,0), 0) AS avg_discount_per_discounted_order_eur
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN order_agg oa ON oa.month = m.month
LEFT JOIN coupon_agg ca ON ca.month = m.month
ORDER BY m.month
note: EUR conversion uses exchange_rates (base=EUR, quote=order currency, as_of=placed_at date); EUR-denominated orders use rate 1 directly since EUR/EUR is not guaranteed to be stored. All 12 months of 2025 are included via calendar_days even if an month had zero qualifying orders/redemptions (shown as 0/NULL rate).
